name: sdlc-workflow
description: One command — `/wf` (`$wf` under Codex), the single SDLC entry point for Claude Code and Codex from one plugin tree — driving a 10-stage lifecycle from intake through retro, with per-slice artifacts, runtime-truth verification, and PO-confirmed stack fingerprinting. 22 keys: the stages, standalone/drivers (design, brainstorm, probe, simplify, auto, yolo), the task minimal lifecycle (non-code work with observed outcomes), navigation (status, recap), lifecycle (close), and routers (ship-plan, docs, observability). Code review is the `/wf review` key; design is `/wf design`; observability foundation is `/wf observability`; quick/standalone flows are `/wf intake` modes (including the audit defect hunt) plus the `/wf probe` and `/wf simplify` keys.

strip.title: Workflow strip
strip.description: Draw the active workflow (stage, slice, next step) above the prompt, in the status line, and in the footer.

suggestNext.title: Suggest the next step
suggestNext.description: After a stage turn, show the workflow's next invocation dim in the prompt box; Tab takes it.

stageCheck.title: Stage-landed check
stageCheck.description: Toast when a /wf stage turn ends without writing its artifact.

questionProgress.title: Question progress
questionProgress.description: Count the questions of an intake or shape turn in the AskUserQuestion dialog.

driverStatus.title: Driver status
driverStatus.description: During /wf auto and /wf yolo, show the driver heartbeat in the status line.

spinnerVerb.title: Stage spinner verb
spinnerVerb.description: While a /wf turn runs, the spinner names the stage (Implementing auth...).

cost.title: Cost row
cost.description: Under the strip, the last stage in dollars and the workflow ledger in tokens.

hubNotice.title: Hub notice
hubNotice.description: At session start, one line under the logo with the sdlc hub version and repos; a toast when the hub stops or returns.

stageCompact.title: Compact after a stage
stageCompact.description: After a /wf stage turn lands its artifact, compact the session with instructions that keep the workflow's position and the person's decisions; every other compaction while a workflow is active gains the same sentence.

probeJournal.title: Probe journal
probeJournal.description: Record which parts of the mod ran, on which host and surface, in ~/.sdlc/mod-probe.jsonl (at most 400 rows, no prompt text); `npm run mod:probe` in the plugin directory prints the verdict.
